title: Small Business Supports – Digital Marketing or Business Mentorship | Community Futures Manitoba

facts.fact: Indigenous business owners in Manitoba (rural and Winnipeg) can apply for up to $750 in supports.
facts.quote: Indigenous business owners in Manitoba (rural & Winnipeg) can apply for up to $750 in supports.

facts.fact: Funding is capped at $750 per entrepreneur under this program.
facts.quote: Funding is capped at $750 per entrepreneur.

facts.fact: Once approved, program funding is paid directly to the service provider or contractor only.
facts.quote: Once approved, funding is paid directly to the service provider/contractor only.

facts.fact: All service providers or contractors under the program must be registered businesses and must provide their business number.
facts.quote: All service providers/contractors must be registered businesses and must provide their business number.

facts.fact: Applications under the program are reviewed and approved as funding allows.
facts.quote: Applications will be reviewed and approved as funding allows.

facts.fact: Eligible business mentorship supports include learning business skills from an experienced professional and gaining helpful business advice.
facts.quote: Learn business skills from an experienced professional
